principles: One gate policy for code and documentation audit.
Escalate based on review evidence, not file path alone.
Fail closed on missing quorum when escalation is required.
Report degraded single-host review as lower assurance.
drivers: User explicitly asked to execute the runtime development after the decision document was updated.
Current direct decision-doc quorum blocks zero-finding documentation changes and conflicts with the new target policy.
DONE gate changes are high-risk and need tests plus process-fact contract coverage.

options.name: B: Add shared review-escalation evaluator and keep decision-doc quorum as compatibility diagnostic
pros: Reusable threshold and degraded fallback logic
Allows diagnostics to explain classification versus required quorum
cons: Requires process-fact registry and CLI schema updates

options.name: C: Remove decision-doc quorum gate entirely

chosen: B: Add shared review-escalation evaluator and keep decision-doc quorum as compatibility diagnostic
rationale: Choose B because it implements the user-facing policy directly while preserving diagnostics and fail-closed quorum behavior when the first REVIEW round exposes enough risk. It also gives degraded 3x1 a visible lower-assurance path rather than hiding it in the old decision-doc quorum code.

preMortem.scenario: Zero-finding decision-doc stories still block DONE.
preMortem.trigger: machine.canFinish continues to call decision-doc quorum unconditionally.
preMortem.consequence: User sees the same old always-on behavior despite the document change.
preMortem.mitigation: Make DONE consume review escalation requiresQuorum and treat direct decision-doc changes as classification only.

preMortem.scenario: Risky first-review findings no longer trigger 3x2.
preMortem.trigger: Evaluator only checks changed files and forgets reviewer findings.
preMortem.consequence: High-risk stories pass with normal DONE after two verified findings.
preMortem.mitigation: Add smoke tests with two verified medium/high reviewer findings in the first review round and assert quorum is required.

preMortem.trigger: Fallback accepts one host without explicit reason or lower-assurance output.
preMortem.consequence: Status claims full two-host review even when only one host ran.
preMortem.mitigation: Require explicit fallback command/evidence and report quorumResult=pass-degraded-3x1 plus assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host.

preMortem.trigger: New command or gate fact is added without registry/level/verifier coverage.
preMortem.consequence: Future docs or handlers can drift silently.
preMortem.mitigation: Update process-fact registry, levels, command policy, CLI schema, and verifier script in CHK-004.
